speech.heard: Cyprus has 5.2 times the services Guyana has. The global median is 57.6%. Guyana is the world's lowest at 14.8%. This counts value added by hotels, restaurants, transport, and financial intermediation. One of the highest is Cyprus at 76.8%. The USA is right behind at 76.3%. China sits right at the median with 57.7%. Other major economies? The UK has 73.1%, Japan has 71.4% and Brazil has 59.7%. Does your daily work provide a service or a physical product?
